real_set: project stratified test split (7,000 images, 700/class); official test partition NOT used
preprocessing: canonical [0,1] grayscale repeated to 3 channels; wrapper bilinear resize to 299x299 (align_corners=False) and internal [0,1]->[-1,1] normalization
interpretation: ImageNet-trained Inception features on upsampled grayscale Fashion-MNIST; use as a relative comparison within this project only.
